newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: IMPORT PRESSURE WEAKENS ZIMBABWE DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: IMPORT PRESSURE WEAKENS ZIMBABWE DOLLAR.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed weaker against most hard units on the back of a combination of importer demand for foreign currency and central Reserve Bank intervention in the market, dealers said.

"We witnessed quite a number of inflows today but the Zimbabwe dollar went down because of pressure on the other side coupled with the central bank which was buying at the 11.2975/3000 level," one dealer said.

The local unit ended the day at 11.3000/3100 versus the key U.S. dollar from 11.2950/3050 on Monday and was also quoted softer on sterling at 18.5000/5200 compared to 18.4820/5260, responding to the U.S. dollar's losses against the British unit overseas.
It was at 2.5300/5500 from 2.5275/5340 against the rand but firmed to 6.5500/5700 from 6.5860/6025 on the mark.
